_doc: THE REAL MAPSTR PEDAGOGY. Each course is a real journey through real French places. Every unit is anchored to a real landmark — 'French is learned where it is lived.' This data drives the interactive Mapstr 'Authentic French Journey to Fluency' experience. Source: SYLLABUS_7-new-courses.docx (client-approved) + brand Mapstr profile https://mapstr.com/user/thefrench.atelier.
tagline: French is learned where it is lived — in the street, at the counter, in the queue, on the quay.

courses.name: FA Foundation
courses.journey: Entirely in Paris over a long weekend.
courses.outcome: Survive in French in everyday travel situations: ask directions, order, repair a breakdown, pay, exchange personal info.
anchors: Classic café near the Alma bridge

signature_unit.title: Se présenter à la Tour Eiffel

courses.name: FA Beginner
courses.journey: From the Normandy coast to Paris.
courses.outcome: Interact in simple everyday situations with autonomy: locate, talk about family & daily life, weather, preferences, complete a market or museum outing.
anchors: Honfleur port (Champlain set sail for Québec)
Le Train Bleu, Gare de Lyon

courses.name: FA Elementary
courses.journey: A route from the Loire Valley to the Atlantic coast and the Basque Country.
courses.outcome: Produce language semi-guided, chain exchanges, express & justify preferences, narrate a short past event, describe a work of art.

courses.name: FA Intermediate
courses.journey: Three very different corners of France in a single immersive journey.
courses.outcome: Produce language autonomously, give & defend opinions, negotiate compromise, handle the unexpected, narrate with nuance, compare cultures.
anchors: Rack railway to the Mer de Glace

courses.name: LSF Foundation
courses.journey: Runs parallel to FA Foundation — high-frequency survival situations, evening live small-group sessions.
courses.outcome: Introduce yourself, count, name objects, describe simply, order a drink, hold a very short closing conversation.

courses.name: LSF Beginner
courses.journey: Practical situations of daily life — shopping, getting around, eating out, describing home, routine, preferences.
courses.outcome: Handle daily-life situations without a script and respond to simple unexpected prompts.

courses.name: LSF Elementary
courses.journey: Complex situations of settling in France — opinions, complaints, phone appointments, work, narration, admin, cultural implicits.
courses.outcome: Produce language with real autonomy and adapt register to the situation.
